canonical_project: Benin National Data Center / Data Center National, Abomey-Calavi
owner: SBIN / Ministry of Digital and Digitalization / ASSI
notes: Government programme documentation identifies construction of the public-administration Data Center National in Abomey-Calavi, with TIA-942 fit-out and national administration interconnection; the 2021-2026 plan calls for optimal use of the national data center in 2022. DCD's March 2026 coverage describes the current national data center as a 300 sqm SBIN-operated facility in Abomey-Calavi and discusses a separate redundancy feasibility study. MW capacity not disclosed.
